messages.content: 我想在聖荷西附近的Walmart買蘋果、米飯和12罐瓶裝水。請顯示產品資訊和庫存情況。

function.name: walmart_purchase
function.description: Retrieve information of items from Walmart including stock availability. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

product_list.description: Items to be purchased listed in an array.

pack_size.description: Size of the product pack if applicable. The size of the array should be equal to product_list. Default is not use it if not specified.

message.reasoning:
We need to call the function walmart_purchase with loc "San Jose" and product_list ["Apples", "Rice", "Bottled Water"] and pack_size [1, 1, 12] maybe? Actually "12罐瓶裝水" means 12 cans of bottled water. So pack_size for water is 12. For apples and rice default. So we pass pack_size [12]? But the array length should match product_list. So we can set pack_size [0,0,12] or just omit for apples and rice. The spec says default is not use it if not specified. So we can provide pack_size [12] but length mismatch. So better to provide pack_size [null,null,12] but not sure. Let's provide pack_size [12] only for water? Might cause mismatch. We can provide pack_size [12] but the function expects same length. So we should provide pack_size [12] for all? That would mean each item has pack size 12 which is wrong. So we can provide pack_size [12] but it's ambiguous.

Better to provide pack_size [12] for water only and leave others unspecified. But the function signature says pack_size?: number[], optional. So we can provide pack_size [12] but then the array length is 1 vs product_list length 3. Might still work? Not sure. I'd rather provide pack_size [12] as separate param? The function expects pack_size array length equal to product_list. So we need to provide [null, null, 12] or [0,0,12]. Let's do [0,0,12].

Thus call function.
